request: Seventy-seventh build (incremental on the seventy-sixth, run 43776798905, Chromium 156.0.8078.100): the workflow-gaps change with review rounds three and four. The chat's /wait-for takes the rest of its line as its selector, only Save schedule starts an interval an earlier version never started (and a save from a stale card keeps it as stored), a one-time scheduled run isn't skipped beside an open run, and Snooze and Skip don't start an interval never started. Runs the unit and browser tests and the typed spoken suite.
